entry.name: gap
entry.label: Inner gap (px)
entry.tooltip: Space, in pixels, between adjacent tiled windows.

entry.name: outerGap
entry.label: Outer gap (px)
entry.tooltip: Space, in pixels, between the tiled area and the screen or panel edges.

entry.name: defaultLayout
entry.label: Default layout
entry.tooltip: Layout used on a desktop with no pinned or saved layout: master-stack, columns, monocle, or spotlight.

entry.name: defaultMasterRatio
entry.label: Default master width
entry.tooltip: Fraction of the usable width given to the master pane (master-stack only). Adjust live with Meta+H / Meta+L.

entry.name: masterRatioStep
entry.label: Master ratio step per keypress
entry.tooltip: How much the master width changes on each Meta+H / Meta+L press.

entry.name: spotlightCornerRatio
entry.label: Spotlight corner size
entry.tooltip: Spotlight layout only: size of each corner window, as a fraction of the screen's width and height.

entry.name: floatOnStart
entry.label: Float new windows by default
entry.tooltip: Newly opened windows start floating instead of tiling. Pull one into the layout on demand with Meta+F.

entry.name: animationsEnabled
entry.label: Enable animations (not implemented yet)
entry.tooltip: Reserved for future animation control. Not implemented yet — KWin animates window geometry changes itself.

entry.name: persistSession
entry.label: Remember layout per desktop
entry.tooltip: Remember each desktop's layout and master width across logout/login.

entry.name: floatClasses
entry.label: Always-float window classes
entry.tooltip: Comma-separated window classes (lowercase) that should never tile. Dialogs, splash screens, and non-resizable windows always float regardless.

entry.name: desktopLayouts
entry.label: Per-desktop pinned layouts (Model B)
entry.tooltip: Pin a layout to a virtual desktop by its 1-based number. Format: 1=master-stack,2=columns,3=spotlight. Meta+T overrides for the session.
